description: Discovered Winkelmann's manuscript diary, detailing the Talisman Crisis from June 3-7: The Talisman must be delivered to the Postumia Cave, and the Arkanje cult is in pursuit.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: #Slacking off and turning into a letter

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: [Accidentally entering a tide zone]

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Qiduo received! Continuing to record the howling cold wind—Trieste 1923, currently 1989 texts recorded, time elapsed 9 hours 12 minutes 52 seconds

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: You encountered the red-haired man Caesar Druni in the library, subdued and interrogated him, learning he is a monitor sent by Termona, revealing the R'lyeh Cultist's attempt to find the eighth medal. Caesar was torn apart by tentacles inside his body while ranting madly, and you disposed of the scene overnight. This morning player6 appeared inexplicably fatigued, all avoided the hotel breakfast and went out, encountering a strong Bora wind, player4, player5, and Bolan were successively blown over by the gale. Currently lying scattered on the streets

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #Crawling toward player4

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: #Find something to stabilize myself as much as possible

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Then Bolan successfully grabs an exposed drainage pipe on the ground

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Try to grab something to control my body

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: #Wait for the wind to die down a bit before looking for others

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: player4 barely hugs a lamppost

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #Hug player4's thigh

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Everyone squeezes into a small restaurant filled with the aroma of coffee, hastily swallowing fried eggs and bread by the window, Gousheng licks milk from a saucer. Although the Bora wind still howls outside, the condensation on the glass temporarily isolates the chaos outside.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "So where do we go next"

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "Okay"

conversation.speaker: player7
conversation.text: "I fully agree"

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #Crawling, giving a thumbs up, no objection

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "I think I should go to the strange person, professor goes to the collector?"

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: #Preparing to go hire a translator.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Who's coming with me?"

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: "What about me, me"

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #Translator crawling

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Alright, the two of us hire a translator"

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Damn it, someone with eyes help me up"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: You find a young man holding a multilingual guide sign in a sheltered spot outside the restaurant. He is wrapped in an oversized sheepskin coat, the sign crookedly written with German/Italian/Slovenian words.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #Wind too strong, crouch low to reduce wind resistance

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "How much?"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Then the sign reads English/German/Italian/Slovenian

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Disdainfully helping player5 up

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: The guide rubs his frostbitten fingers, twenty lira"

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "How long"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "One day"

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Do we need to cover your food and lodging?"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: The guide grinned, showing neat new teeth. A meal will do.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "I think he's good, let's go with him."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: He adjusted his backpack straps and stood up. "Also, if it runs past midnight, there's a five lira night shift fee."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "Ok, no problem."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #Squinting eyes "20, includes meals, night shift included."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Split into two groups and set off.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Marco opened the door a crack, his single eye scanning everyone gloomily. What now? His burly arm blocked the doorway.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: (Barbecue, should we be more forceful?

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "Well... it's like this."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Marco's single eye narrowed slightly. He silently stepped back, clearing the way. The master is in the study dealing with letters. He said gruffly.

conversation.speaker: player7
conversation.text: "Yes, and it's no small trouble."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: #Go communicate.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Antonio entered the living room leaning on a silver-inlaid cane, his empty sleeve elegantly tucked into his suit buttonhole. "What troubles have my friends encountered?"

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "Sigh... alright, perhaps we don't need to let things get so tense."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "In a sense, though he did a decent job delivering messages."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: #Languidly

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Antonio elegantly tilted the silver teapot. "Trieste always greets guests with trouble." He gently pushed the teacup across the table. "But elegant solutions are often hidden in the aroma of tea."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "Therefore, we might be able to reach some form of cooperation. We will search for the whereabouts of that item for you."

conversation.speaker: player7
conversation.text: "Yes, sincere cooperation between us will surely yield greater results."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Antonio gently set down his teacup. "Forgive my curiosity, but what exactly are you all searching for?"

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #Taps the table

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Antonio chuckled, ripples forming in his teacup. "Surveillance?" Four one-eyed, burly men identical to Marco silently appeared in the doorway. "Being surveilled often means you've touched upon the truth. I look forward to you achieving results that satisfy me."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "Well, this matter isn't particularly important."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Give me men."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "We are concerned that that group might interfere with your search for the medal."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Antonio elegantly spread his right hand. "As for the Skin Brotherhood? Sounds like sailors' tales of sea monsters. I haven't heard of it, but my study does have a few 17th-century Mediterranean books of strange tales." His cane pointed towards the slightly ajar oak door at the end of the corridor. "Feel free to browse—Marco will prepare coffee for you."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "We might need to ask for your help at some point to get some assistants to prevent our failure."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Your bodyguards, they look very strong."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Four burly men approach. Hans will be responsible for your safety. Antonio lightly taps one of them with the tip of his cane. They are particularly skilled at... dealing with overly curious onlookers.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "A good deal."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Meanwhile,

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Hello, sir."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Grausinger suddenly stands up. His teeth grip a stack of yellowed paper scraps, his empty sleeves flapping wildly against player4's knees.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "This sudden visit is a bit presumptuous."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Grausinger's pupils suddenly light up. He pushes aside a pile of rotten food cans with his knee, bites a leather-bound diary with his teeth, and stuffs it into player4's hand.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Open it and look.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: The diary's content is in German. The guide translates for you, but the handwriting is chaotic and blurry, making it seem very difficult: Escaped from them... returned to Trieste in Rome, although von Junz believes this cult might be survivors from a more distant era... ... seem to prefer living (dwelling?) in underground caves. There are many karst caves nearby (the name originates from "Grast", the Slovenian name for this place), perhaps providing ideal... ... from elsewhere (Andromeda Nebula? Secret of the Worms), they can manifest as... ... "mermaids"... through the skin visible... internal organs... pulsating bright... ... Ghatanothoa. Some are believed to worship the wind-walkers, Itha (itha)...... overheard them discussing some task their master gave the cult many years ago, but not yet fulfilled. The unspecified punishment is... ... fingers, toes, eyes, limbs... grafted into the body... perhaps moving according to its own will, or obeying... ... ordered to remain vigilant and collect all items with magical power to offer to the invisible...

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Them? You mean escaping from the skin brotherhood?"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Grausinger nods frantically, blood seeping from his toothless gums. He bangs his forehead against the earlier French part of the diary.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Oh, you mean the first half."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: After hitting the diary, a yellowed photo drifts onto the moldy carpet.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Is it convenient to give us the diary? I might need to find someone who knows French."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: A young Grausinger with both arms intact, smiling and hugging a woman in a dress and a little boy holding a toy boat. Behind the three, the Alpine foothills are full of edelweiss. The back of the photo is written in pen: Mittenwald, 1909.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "This is... your family."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Grausinger uses his head to push open the door, his empty sleeves whipping the air like a whip. He kicks over a tin bucket with his bare feet, making a loud noise, then uses his stumps to roughly shove player4 onto the street, constantly hissing and spitting towards the northeast.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Northeast? The skin brotherhood is in the northeast?"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Grausinger shakes his head frantically, bites the diary with his teeth and flips to the back part.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "So it's those lunatics who serve the reptiles?"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: He shrinks back into the darkness in terror.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "The Cave of Winds is their lair?"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Grausinger bites a pen with his teeth and scribbles a passage on the inside of the door panel: After leaving the Wind Cave—sever the umbilical cord connected to the myth! Otherwise, you will become paving stones for the Old Ones like me! Then he slams the door shut.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Silence.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: [Strayed into the tide area].

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "We've obtained important information. Let's go."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: (So where to meet up?)

conversation.speaker: player7
conversation.text: Oh, what's going on? #Raise hands to chest level.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: @player3 @player5

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "Ahem..."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Gou Sheng darts out from player4's arms, emitting a threatening growl at the thugs' shiny leather shoes.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Huh? Alright."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: After Bolan's explanation, the four thugs instantly return to their previous state.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Uh, how about we grab a meal? You guys..."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Suddenly, you notice Montanelli's butler has silently approached you at some point, placing a document folder tied with red silk on the coffee table.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "What's this?"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: The four thugs stand motionless like statues, as if they didn't hear your words.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Silence

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "The master is already familiar with that diary. Lord Antonio has informed us of the details. Since we are temporary teammates now, we will immediately give you the translated content."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Oh, I see."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Then the butler leaves the area.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Let's take a look at the fully translated content.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: May 3rd
